ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Iron eyes with bronze pupils are the corpus's image of exceptionally hard, penetrating sight, yet each retained use stresses what even such eyes cannot see, measure, or withstand.
EvidenceBody: Mi'an Xianjie says such eyes cannot see through the patriarchal saying, Guxue Zhenzhe says they cannot measure Mazu's displayed activity, and an Anji master says they still shatter before the matter raised at his opening assembly.
